| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Marker blur** `sigma` | 2 | 0.5 to 10 px | The marker is the image blurred by a Gaussian of this sigma, cut at 4 sigma. |
| **Neighbors** `connectivity` | 8 neighbors | 8 neighbors, 4 neighbors | Which pixels count as joined when the reconstruction spreads. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
